name: Troll Sigma Tower  😎
desc:
Are you a true Sigma? Prove it in the Troll Sigma Tower! 💪
Full of brain-bending slaps and goofy challenges — only the strongest minds survive!

🖐️ Watch out! Other players can SLAP you off the tower!
🏆 Reach the top to earn the Fire Slap and Flying Carpet then show who's the boss!

👍 Like the game and join the group to unlock the shortcut and Fire Slap!
Thanks for playing, legend. Stay Sigma. 😎
